helpText: 🤖 Valencia Transit Bot Available commands: /departure, /d — Next departures between two stations · Tap without arguments for the interactive flow · Or type directly: <origin> - <destination> or <origin> to <destination> · You can also type without a command: it's the default search /lines — View lines and stops /language — Change language /cancel — Cancel current search /help — Show this help
disclaimer: ℹ️ Scheduled times. Actual times may vary.
noMoreToday: No more departures today from {{origin}} to {{destination}}.
disambiguationOrigin: 🔍 Multiple stations found as origin. Which one did you mean?
disambiguationDestination: 🔍 Multiple stations found as destination. Which one did you mean?
errNoService: ❌ No active service at this time
errUnknown: ❌ Unexpected error. Please try again later.
stationNotFoundInFlow: ❌ I don't know any station called "{{name}}". Try again or type /cancel to exit.
